pages.text: Underground food supplies attract $(l:mechanics/decay#pests)pests$(), too. Food chests placed $(bold)at least 10 blocks$() below the surface may draw silverfish.$(br2)They emerge around the chest, making them a pest to watch for when storing food underground.

The deeper a chest lies beneath the surface, the more silverfish an infestation may bring, up to eight at once.$(br2)Silverfish drawn to a food chest remember its location and make their way back to it when there's no enemy to chase.

When silverfish appear, you may also find silverfish eggs in the chest that attracted them, up to $(bold)five eggs$() at a time.$(br2)The eggs remain alongside the food, ready to collect. You can also obtain them through $(l:minersdelighttfc/piercing_harvests)piercing and gathering$().
